newsitem.title: USA: Two reported dead in Wisconsin plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Two reported dead in Wisconsin plane crash.

text.p: Two people were killed on Monday when a single-engine plane crashed in a hay field, the Winnebago County Sheriff's Office said.
The plane burned on impact and no other aircraft appeared to have been involved in the incident, investigators said.
The accident occurred not far from the annual Experimental Aircraft Association meeting which draws thousands of flight enthusiasts from around the globe.
The plane that crashed may have been a home-built craft, investigators said, but it was not known if it was in the area because of the aircraft meeting.
